classification: Original service-interface proposal; no machine commands

stations.name: Qualified preparation/cell service
stations.input_contract: Finished rated cells and contained dispersion jobs
stations.output_contract: Cell acceptance, preparation and settled-state receipts

stations.name: Closed synchronized measurement service
stations.input_contract: Approved run request, accepted state, calibration and clock contract
stations.output_contract: Pressure stream, image stream, settings, failures and safe-release receipt

stations.name: Read-only metrology analysis
stations.input_contract: Immutable raw data, units, calibration, segmentation version
stations.output_contract: Area/perimeter/width/volume/event outputs with uncertainties and lineage

stations.name: Scientific review/comparison
stations.input_contract: Branch evidence, control/repeat hierarchy, conflict dispositions
stations.output_contract: Qualified/inconclusive classification, never plot matching by fiat

stations.name: Contained closeout and archive
stations.input_contract: Returned safe cell/aliquot plus all evidence
stations.output_contract: Disposition, cleaning/inspection receipt and archived lineage
